4\. Copied version line breaks the download urls 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
The architect's version lookup runs grep '^pipeline:', which prints the whole line (`pipeline:
v1.0.0). The next step sets V=<version> without saying to strip the pipeline:` prefix, which
room.py itself removes with ^pipeline:[ \t]*(\S+). If the line is used as is, both download URLs
point at a nonexistent ref and the protocol won't load.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The skill's `grep '^pipeline:'` returns `pipeline: v1.0.0`, but `V` must be `v1.0.0` alone. ## Fix Focus Areas - .claude/skills/agent-room/SKILL.md[22-24] ## Recommended Fix Replace the grep with `sed -n 's/^pipeline:[[:space:]]*\([^[:space:]]*\).*/\1/p'` (or `awk '/^pipeline:/{print $2}'`) so the command prints only the version, matching room.py's own parse. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
